raw_proposal.draft:
Dear [Customer Name],

Thank you for reaching out to Cedar Systems. We understand that your construction services team is facing challenges with disconnected teams and are interested in workflow coordination and account reporting.

We are pleased to arrange a discovery meeting to better understand your specific requirements and how we can assist you. Please let us know a convenient time for this discussion.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
Cedar Systems Team
[Contact Information]
